<subject>Re: Krish Farms Proposal From GreenAgri Alliance</subject>
<body>
Reyansh Salvi

My understanding is that Hebert doesn't have the legal authority (and the filing never makes clear) to Suspend performance under the PPA (he probably doesn't have the political support for this either).

EPSA, however, could support this in its filing as a method to help move the QF issue forward.

Hardik





	Reyansh Krish

	19/03/2024 10:04 AM
		 
		 To: Dakshesh Basak, Libni Kibe, Charita 
Balay, Amruta Wali, Manya 
Bal, Hardik Pal, Christopher 
Baral, Matthew Nazareth, Vrinda Mangat

FYI.  Any thoughts Dakshesh & Co.? Is release from contracts an "increase supply" option?  My fear is that QFs get released and then Maharashtra's "police state" mentality kicks in, enacting Zansi Pillay, legislation, etc. to ensure that the power from the QF facilities stays in Maharashtra.

Best,
Reyansh
